title: EvidenceRegistry
description: Evidence registry. references/00-contracts.md §1. Evidence is canonically stored here; every other location writes only evidence_refs[] strings. Every evidence_ref must resolve to exactly one entry.

evidence_registry.description: Keys are EV-ids and values are the entries; each key must equal the entry's id field

evidence_entry.description: One of three types: present (exists in the manuscript), absence (does not exist in the manuscript), or external (a traceable fact from an external public scientific data source)

quote.description: Excerpt of the paper's original text, for manual verification

absence_evidence.description: Absence-type evidence. quote and locator are forbidden — never fabricate a quotation for content that does not exist.

searched_locations.description: Must reflect searches actually performed. Absence must not be claimed beyond the searched scope.

search_terms.description: Search terms in both Chinese and English

search_result.description: partial_match_ambiguous cannot support an absence conclusion; fields citing it must be judged ambiguous

external_evidence.description: An external fact obtained by X1 from a public scientific data source. Do not create this object on API failure; produce a system_limitation instead. Storing credentials, cookies, Authorization headers, or the full response is forbidden.

endpoint.description: The public HTTPS endpoint actually called; must not contain credentials or sensitive query parameters

normalized_input.description: Sorted and normalized public query parameters; API keys, cookies, and Authorization headers are forbidden

database_version.description: The release/version/timestamp published by the data source; null when the source does not provide one — never guess

retrieval_status.description: not_found is limited to a well-formed exact identifier receiving an authoritative 404/explicit zero-record answer; zero hits for a semantic query is not_addressed

external_assertion.description: An atomic fact normalized from the external response; comparison conclusions against the manuscript are written only to extraction_signal.external_check.

source_path.description: A verifiable field path within the response, e.g. protocolSection.statusModule.studyFirstSubmitDate

created_by.description: For troubleshooting; does not affect semantics

evidence_ref.description: A key into the evidence_registry. Must resolve to exactly one entry.

evidence_refs.description: Array of evidence references. The canonical storage form; the rendering layer expands them into quotes and page numbers.
